about: The "Tasks created here" row above a session's composer: its fixed words and the sentence its
collapsed form writes — one set of cases both clients are proved against. The shared
(@orbit/shared, what the web renders) against this file; the native client reads the same file,
so the two ends cannot drift into two sentences.
`copy`: the row's fixed words. `replacesPrefix` is followed directly by the replaced task's
title, `createdInChip` (the Tasks page's filter chip) by the session's title.
`countLine`: `{running, failed, done, total}` → `text`, the counts exactly as
`GET /sessions/:id/created-tasks` returns them (they count rows, not tasks). `N running` and
`N failed` are written only when N > 0; `done/total done` always is; the parts are joined by
`singleNamesTheTask`: when `total` is 1 the collapsed row writes no count sentence; it names
the task and shows its status pill instead, as the Watching row does. With `total` 0 the session
created nothing and there is no row.
